textRuns.value: The first four cards count the period on the first card: "Selected" (the dates you picked) or the last quarter, used when no dates are selected (over the whole extract everyone would be new). Pareto: bars are deliveries per engineer, the line their running share; everyone left of where it crosses 80% is class A. Segments score recency (days since the last delivery), frequency (quarters with a delivery) and volume 1–5. The cohort matrix: of the engineers who first delivered in a quarter, the share still delivering N quarters later. Ignores the Team slicer.
